heading: Our Proven PHP Web Development Process is Smart, Lean, & Agile
text2: Our php web development process runs from understanding your idea to launching and supporting the finished product. Each step has a clear outcome so you always know what is happening and what comes next.

items.title: Requirement Workshop
items.text: We map your goals, users and workflows so PHP Web Development solves the right problem.

items.title: Technical Analysis
items.text: We choose the stack, hosting and integrations that fit your budget and growth plans.

items.title: UI/UX Prototyping
items.text: Wireframes and clickable prototypes let you approve the look and flow before development.

items.title: Deployment and Support
items.text: We deploy to production, hand over documentation and stay on for maintenance.

items.title: Development and Testing
items.text: We build in sprints with code review and testing at every milestone.

items.title: Functional Specification
items.text: Features, data models and APIs are written down so the build is predictable.
